Railway RRB Paramedical CEN 03/2025 DV Admit Card 2026 - Complete Details

Short Details : Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) has released the DV Admit Card for the post of Paramedical Staff Posts on the official website of RRB. This recruitment was released for 434 posts. Applications for the Railway RRB Paramedical Staff Recruitment 2025 were accepted from 09 August 2025, to 18 September 2025. The CBT examination was conducted on 10 to 12 March 2026. Candidates who have appeared in this Examination can check their RRB Paramedical Staff CEN.No.03/2025 CBT-I DV Admit Card 2026 from the link provided below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 09 August 2025
  • Last Date : 18 September 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 18 September 2025
  • Application Status : 09 December 2025
  • Revised Exam Date : 11, 12 & 13 March 2026
  • Exam City Details : 02 March 2026
  • Admit Card : 08 March 2026
  • Answer Key : 21 March 2026
  • Result/Cutoff : 29 May 2026
  • DV Admit Card : 16 June 2026

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 500/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 250/-
  • All Category Female : Rs. 250/-
  • After Appear the Stage I Exam
  • UR, OBC, EWS Fee Refund : Rs. 400/-
  • SC,  ST, PH, Female Refund : Rs. 250/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
